# VerticalStack

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Arranges child elements from top to bottom with configurable spacing.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new VerticalStack()
new VerticalStack(options: VerticalStackOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`children`](#children): The children elements in this stack (exposed for collection initializer syntax)
- [`spacing`](#spacing): Uniform gap between adjacent children.

### `children`

```typescript
readonly children: IElement[]
```

*read-only*

The children elements in this stack (exposed for collection initializer syntax)

> A list you can add to and remove from. The property itself cannot be replaced.

### `spacing`

```typescript
spacing: number
```

Uniform gap between adjacent children.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/healthcare/outpatient-appointment-letter`:

```typescript
s.spacing = 3;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/compliance-archival/pdf-compliance`:

```typescript
made.spacing = 4;
```

## Methods

- [`add`](#add): Adds a child element to this stack.
- [`getChildren`](#getchildren): Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery).
- [`renderStateful`](#renderstateful): Renders this vertical stack with state tracking for pagination.
- [`resetState`](#resetstate): Resets the internal state, preparing the element for a fresh render.

### `add`

```typescript
add(child: IElement | string | readonly string[]): void
```

Adds a child element to this stack.

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/qr-codes`:

```typescript
col.add(url);
```

Example, from `code-recipes/images-svg-colour/shapes-and-borders`:

```typescript
stack.add(t);
```

### `getChildren`

```typescript
getChildren(): readonly IElement[]
```

Canonical child traversal for engine tree walks (the default-style cascade, font/image discovery). Container elements return their direct renderable children; leaf elements omit it. Optional so existing custom IElement implementations remain source-compatible.

### `renderStateful`

```typescript
renderStateful(ctx: RenderContext, width: number): RenderStatus
```

Renders this vertical stack with state tracking for pagination. Children that implement IStatefulElement will be rendered with overflow support.

- `ctx`: The render context
- `width`: The available width for this element

### `resetState`

```typescript
resetState(): void
```

Resets the internal state, preparing the element for a fresh render. Also resets state of all stateful children.
